items.headline: Flood Watch issued October 10 at 3:04PM EDT until October 11 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast North Carolina, including the
following areas, Coastal Brunswick, Coastal New Hanover, Coastal
Pender, Columbus, Inland Brunswick, Inland New Hanover and Inland
Pender and northeast South Carolina, including the following areas,
Central Horry, Coastal Georgetown, Coastal Horry, Inland Georgetown
and Northern Horry.

* WHEN...Through Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Tropical moisture continues to overspread the area tonight
through Sunday with showers and thunderstorms producing heavy
rainfall at times. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches
are expected with the highest totals likely in the Cape Fear
area. A few areas could receive up to 6 inches in thunderstorms,
mainly tonight. This excessive rainfall could lead to flooding,
especially in flood prone and low-lying areas.
- weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 10 at 2:35PM EDT until October 10 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip currents.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, up to one foot of inundation
above ground level expected in low-lying areas near shorelines
and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Coastal Horry and Coastal Georgetown Counties.

* WHEN...For the High Rip Current Risk, until 8 PM EDT this
evening. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 6 PM to 11 PM
EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Vulnerable causeways to and from local beaches will
experience minor coastal flooding. Low-lying roads and
locations along the Intracoastal Waterway and adjacent tidal
creeks will observe minor coastal flooding. Check with local
officials for the latest information regarding coastal flood
impacts and closures. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Affected areas listed are based on
average tide conditions. Additional locations may experience
flooding during periods of heavy rainfall, high winds, or
other factors.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 10 at 6:23PM EDT until October 12 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
4 to 7 ft.

* WHERE...Northeast South Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
